label: MikroTik cAP ax
description: Ceiling access point, Wi-Fi 6 dual band: 2x gigabit Ethernet (one with PoE-out), 802.11ax 574 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz and 1200 Mbit/s on 5 GHz.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 2x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports with 1 of them offering PoE-out; wireless 2.4 GHz max data rate 574 Mbit/s (802.11b/g/n/ax) and 5 GHz max data rate 1200 Mbit/s. The PoE-out port is the one marked, so a lab should not assume it can power a second device from either port.
